title: Reproducible repository access
prompt: Mount a public GitHub repository at a specific commit and produce a reproducible code review.

examples.code:
resources:
  - type: github_repository
    url: https://github.com/OWNER/REPO
    mount_path: /workspace/repo
    checkout:
      type: commit
      sha: FULL_COMMIT_SHA
examples.label: YAML reference excerpt

takeaway: Mount a public GitHub repository at a specific commit and produce a reproducible code review.
